game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Snow Fort, a snowball fort: the firewood keeper must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Parameter Potion: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snow Fort: a snowball fort
core_gameplay_loop: In Snow Fort, repeat each round: Pass parameters into a function so one recipe makes many potions. Each round, yeti raiders strike the hearth fire, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the potions value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the hearth fire from yeti raiders in Snow Fort: keep the potions meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 39-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: potions drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 39-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Parameter Potion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Parameter Potion' (Week 6 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Snow Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Snow Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 39 seconds while potions > 0.
